verses.text: Ha ka snem banyngkong jong u Sirus syiem Persha, ba yn ioh pyndep ia ka ktien ba u Trai U la kren da ka shyntur u Jeremiia, uTrai U la pynkhih ia ka mynsiem u Sirus syiem Persha. Une u la pynmih ka jingpynbna ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei bad u da thoh artad ia ka.
“U Sirus syiem Persha u ong kumne: U Trai, u Blei ka bneng, U la ai ha nga ïa ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew, bad U la hukum ïa nga ban tei kawei ka ïing na ka bynta jong U ha Jerusalem, kaba ha Juda.

Te uno uno u briew uba don hapdeng jong phi, uba dei na u paid jong U baroh, to u Blei jong u Un don ryngkat bad u. To un leit kiew sha Jerusalem kaba ha Juda, bad un tei biang ïa ka ïing u Trai u Blei ki Israel—U long u Blei Uba don ha Jerusalem.

Ïa uwei pa uwei uba dang im, ha kano kano ka jaka ba u shong u sah, to ki briew jong kata ka jaka jong u kin ïarap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar, da ki mar ki mata bad ki jynri jyndup, nalor ki jyntyrwa ai sngewbha na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei kaba ha Jerusalem.”

Kumta ki rangbah jong ki ïingkur ka Juda bad Benjamin, ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, man la u briew baroh u la ïoh jingpynkhih na u Blei ha ka mynsiem, u la pynkhreh ban leit kiew ban tei biang ïa ka ïing u Trai kaba ha Jerusalem.

Baroh ki briew kiba ju ïashong ïasah hajan jong ki ki la ïarap ïa ki da ki khiew ki pliang rupa, da ka ksiar, da ki mar ki mata, da ki jynri jyndup, bad da ki kynja mar ki bakordor, nalor kiei kiei ba ki la shu ai sngewbha.
U syiem Sirus u la sei ruh ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka ïing u Trai, ïa kiba u Nebukhadnessar u la rong noh na Jerusalem bad u la buh ha ka ïing ki blei jong u.
U Sirus syiem Persha u la phah sei ïa ki ha u Mithredath u nongsumar jynkynshew, bad une u la ñiew ïa ki ha u Sheshbassar u rangbah ki Juda.
Ka jingkheiñ ïa kine ka la long kumne: shihajar tylli ki dabor ksiar, shihajar tylli ki dabor rupa, arphew khyndai tylli ki jynthang dhup,
laiphew tylli ki khuri ksiar, ar hajar sawspah shiphew tylli ki khuri rupa, bad shihajar tylli kiwei pat ki kynja jyndiang.
Ki tiar ki tar ksiar bad rupa baroh ki la long sanhajar sawspah hynriewphew khyndai tylli baroh. U Sheshbassar u la wan rah ïa kine baroh, mynba la wan ïalam ïa ki mraw thma na Babilon sha Jerusalem.

Te kine ki long kita ki briew jong ka jylla kiba la wan phai na ka jinglong mraw, ïa kiba u Nebukhadnessar u la ring mraw sha Babilon. Ki la wan phai sha Jerusalem bad Juda, uwei pa uwei sha la shnong lajong.
Ki la wan bad u Zerubbabel, u Jeshwa, u Nehemia, u Seraïa, u Reelaïa, u Mordekai, u Bilshan, u Mispar, u Bikbai, u Rehum bad u Baana. Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki rangbah jong u paid Israel:
ki khun u Parosh, arhajar shispah hynñiewphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Shephatia, laispah hynñiewphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Ara, hynñiewspah hynñiewphew san ngut.
Ki khun u Pahath-Moab, kata ka mut ki khun u Jeshwa bad u Joab arhajar phraspah khat-ar ngut.
Ki khun u Elam, shihajar arspah sanphew saw ngut.
Ki khun u Zattu, khyndaispah sawphew san ngut.
Ki khun u Zakkai, hynñiewspah hynriewphew ngut.
Ki khun u Bani, hynriewspah sawphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Bebai, hynriewspah arphew lai ngut.
Ki khun u Askad, shihajar arspah arphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Adonikam, hynriewspah hynriewphew hynriew ngut.
Ki khun u Bikbai ar hajar sanphew hynriew ngut.
Ki khun u Adin, sawspah sanphew saw ngut.
Ki khun u Ater, kata ka mut jong u Hezekia, khyndaiphew phra ngut.
Ki khun u Besai, laispah arphew lai ngut.
Ki khun u Jora, shispah khat-ar ngut.
Ki khun u Hashum, arspah arphew lai ngut.
Ki khun u Gibbar, khyndaiphew san ngut.
Ki khun u Bethlehem, shispah arphew lai ngut.
Ki rangbah na Netopha, sanphew hynriew ngut.
Ki rangbah na Anathoth, shispah arphew phra ngut.
Ki khun u Asmabeth, sawphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Kiriath-Jearim, u Khephira bad u Beeroth hynñiewspah sawphew lai ngut.
Ki khun u Rama bad u Geba, hynriewspah arphew wei ngut.
Ki rangbah na Mikhmas, shispah arphew ar ngut.
Ki rangbah na Bethel bad Ai, arspah arphew lai ngut.
Ki khun u Nebo, sanphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Makbish, shispah sanphew hynriew ngut.
Ki khun uwei pat u Elam, shihajar arspah sanphew saw ngut.
Ki khun u Harim, laispah arphew ngut.
Ki khun u Lod, u Hadid, bad u Ono, hynñiewspah arphew san ngut.
Ki khun u Jerikho, laispah sawphew san ngut.
Ki khun u Senaa laihajar hynriewspah laiphew ngut.
Ki lyngdoh: ki khun u Jedaïa na ka ïing ka sem u Jeshwa, khyndaispah hynñiewphew lai ngut.
Ki khun u Immer, shihajar sanphew ar ngut.
Ki khun u Pashhur, shihajar arspah sawphew hynñiew ngut.
Ki khun u Harim, shihajar khathynñiew ngut.
Ki Lebi: ki khun u Jeshwa bad u Kadmiel, kiba na ka ïing khun u Hodabia, hynñiewphew saw ngut.
Ki nongrwai: ki khun u Asaph, shispah arphew phra ngut.
Ki khun jong ki nongap khyrdop: ki khun u Shallum, ki khun u Ater, ki khun u Talmon, ki khun u Akkub, ki khun u Hatita, bad ki khun u Shobai, baroh lang shispah laiphew khyndai ngut.
Ki shakri ka tempyl: ki khun u Ziha, ki khun u Hasupha, ki khun u Tabbaoth,
ki khun u Keros, ki khun u Siaha, ki khun u Padon,
ki khun u Lebana, ki khun u Hakaba, ki khun u Akkub,
ki khun u Hagab, ki khun u Shamlai, ki khun u Hanan,
ki khun u Giddel, ki khun u Gahar, ki khun u Reaïa,
ki khun u Resin, ki khun u Nekoda, ki khun u Gassam,
ki khun u Ussa, ki khun u Pasea, ki khun u Besai,
ki khun u Asna, ki khun u Meunim, ki khun u Nephisim,
ki khun u Bakbuk, ki khun u Hakupha, ki khun u Harhur,
ki khun u Basluth, ki khun u Mehida, ki khun u Harsha,
ki khun u Barkos, ki khun u Sisera, ki khun u Tema,
ki khun u Nesia, bad ki khun u Hatipha.
Ki khun jong ki shakri u Solomon: ki khun u Sotai, ki khun u Hassophereth, ki khun u Peruda,
ki khun u Jaala, ki khun u Darkon, ki khun u Giddel,
ki khun u Shephatia, ki khun u Hattil, ki khun u Pokhereth-ha-Zabaim, bad ki khun u Ami.
Baroh ki shakri ka tempyl bad ki khun ki kti jong ki shakri u Solomon ki la long laispah khyndaiphew ar ngut.
Kine ki dei kito kiba la wan na Telmela, Telharsha, Kherub, Addan, bad Immer, kibym shym la lah ban pynsabut ïa la ka ïing kur ne ka jinghiar pateng jong ki, la ki dei ki Israel:
ki khun u Delaïa, ki khun u Tobia, bad ki khun u Nekoda, hynriewspah sanphew ar ngut.
Nangta, na ki khun ki lyngdoh: ki khun u Habaïa, ki khun u Hakkos, bad ki khun u Barzillai (une u la shim kurim na ki khun kynthei u Barzillai nong Gilead, bad sa khot kyrteng ïa u kumta).
Kine ki la wad ïa ki kot ki sla ba buh jingkynmaw ïa ki jinghiar pateng jong ki, hynrei ym lap ïa ki hangta, te kumta la weng noh ïa ki na ka jinglong lyngdoh, ba kim long ki bakhuid.
Kumta u lat u la khang ïa ki ban bam ïa ka jynbam ka bakhuid tam, haduh ban da don u lyngdoh u ban wad jingmut da ka Urim bad Thummim.
U paidlang baroh phar u la don sawphew ar hajar laispah hynriewphew ngut,
nalor ki shakri shynrang bad ki shakri kynthei jong ki hynñiew hajar laispah laiphew hynñiew ngut, bad ki la don arspah ngut ki nongrwai shynrang bad kynthei.
Ki kulai jong ki ki la long hynñiewspah laiphew hynriew tylli, ki khashor jong ki arspah sawphew san tylli,
ki ut jong ki sawspah laiphew san tylli, bad ki kada jong ki ki la don hynriew hajar hynñiewspah arphew tylli.
Haba ki la poi ha ka ïing u Trai ha Jerusalem, la don ki rangbah ïing kur kiba la tyrwa ki jynai sngewbha na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei, ban tei biang ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka.
Katba kot la ka bor ki la ai ha ka jynkynshew na ka bynta ka jingtrei hynriewphew wei hajar darik ka ksiar, sanhajar mina ka rupa, bad shispah riam ki jaiñ lyngdoh.

Ki lyngdoh, ki Lebi bad katto katne na ki paidbah ki la shong ha Jerusalem bad hajan hapa. Ki nongrwai, ki nongap khyrdop bad ki shakri tempyl ki la shong ha la ki shnong, ki Israel pat de baroh ha la ki shnong ki shnong.
Te haba u bnai u bahynñiew u la poi, bad ki paid Israel ki la don ha la ki shnong ki shnong, ki paidbah ki la ïalum lang ha Jerusalem khrui rui rui.

Hangta la ïeng u Jeshwa khun u Jozadak, bad ki para lyngdoh jong u, bad u Zerubbabel khun u Shealtiel lem bad ki kur ki jait jong u, bad ki la tei ïa ka duwan u Blei ki Israel ban tyrwa jynkñia thang halor jong ka, kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ u Moses, u briew u Blei.
Ki la pynïeng ïa ka duwan bad ki la tyrwa halor jong ka ïa ki jynkñia thang ha u Trai, mynstep bad janmiet, namarba ki la tieng ïa ki jait bynriew kiba baroh sawdong jong ki.
Ki la rakhe ïa ka niam ka rukom jong ki ïing trep, kumba la hukum; bad ki la tyrwa ïa ki jynkñia thang kiba man ka sngi, katta sien kumba la hukum, katba donkam ha kawei pa kawei ka sngi.

Hadien kata la don ki jingkñia thang kiba ter shi ter, ki jingkñia ha u ’naithymmai, bad ha ki jingkhawai niam baroh ba la buh ban burom ïa u Trai, bad ki jyntyrwa jong u briew baroh uba don jyntyrwa sngewbha ha u Trai.
Naduh ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u bahynñiew, ki la sdang ban tyrwa ïa ki jynkñia thang ha u Trai. Hynrei ïa ka nongrim jong ka tempyl u Trai ym pat shym la buh.

Kumta ki la ai peisa ïa ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng nangta ka bam, ka dih, bad ka umphniang ha ki Sidon bad ki Tirus ba kin wan rah dieng kedar na Lebanon sha duriaw haduh Joppa, kumba la ïoh bor na u Sirus syiem Persha.

Te ha ka snem ka ba-ar jong ka jingwan phai jong ki sha ka ïing u Blei ha Jerusalem, ha u bnai ba-ar, u Zerubbabel khun u Shealtiel bad u Jeshwa khun u Jozadak ki la sdang ban trei, lem bad kiwei pat ki kur ki jait jong ki, ki lyngdoh, ki Lebi bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai sha Jerusalem na ka jinglong mraw. Ki la thung ïa ki Lebi, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, ban peit ïa ka jingtrei ha ka ïing u Trai.

Kumta u Jeshwa, ki khun jong u bad ki kur ki jait jong u, lem bad u Kadmiel, ki khun jong u bad ki khun u Juda, baroh lang ki la peit ïa ki nongtrei ha ka ïing u Blei, ryngkat bad ki khun u Henadad, ki Lebi, ki khun jong ki bad ki kur ki jait jong ki.

Haba ki nongtei ki la seng ïa ka nongrim jong ka tempyl u Trai, ki lyngdoh ha la ki jaiñ leh niam jong ki ki la wan bad ki turoi, nangta sa ki Lebi, ki khun u Asaph bad la ki shalymmen ban ïaroh ïa u Trai, katkum ki jingbuh aiñ u Dabid syiem Israel.

Te ki la rwai kylliang ktien, da kaba ïaroh bad ainguh ïa u Trai, “Naba U long u babha, naba ka jingieid jong U ïa ki Israel ka neh junom.” Ki paidbah baroh ki la risa jam haba ki la ïaroh ïa u Trai, namarba la seng ïa ka nongrim jong ka ïing u Trai.

Hynrei bun na ki lyngdoh, ki Lebi bad ki rangbah ïing kur, ki ’riewtymmen kiba la ïohi ïa ka ïing ka bamynshuwa, ki la ïam da ka sur ka bajam haba ki la ïohi ba la seng ïa ka nongrim jong kane ka ïing; la bun bah ki la risa jam da ka jingkmen.
Kumta ym don ba lah ban pynïapher ïa ka jingsawa jong ka jingrisa jingkmen na ka jingsawa jong ka jingïam ki briew, namarba ki paidbah ki la risa jam, bad ïa ka jingsawa la ïohsngew shaduh sha jngai.
Te haba ki nongshun jong ki Juda bad ki Benjamin ki la ïohsngew ba ki mraw kiba la wan phai, ki ïatei ïa ka tempyl ha u Trai, u Blei ki Israel,

ki la wan ïakynduh ïa u Zerubbabel bad ïa ki rangbah ïing kur, bad ki la ong ha ki, “Shah lem ba ngin ïatei bad phi. Ngi ruh ngi mane ïa u Blei jong phi kum ma phi, bad ngi ju kñia ha U naduh ki sngi u Esarhaddon syiem Assiria, uba la wan ïalam ïa ngi shane.”

Hynrei u Zerubbabel, u Jeshwa, bad kiwei pat ki rangbah ïing kur ha Israel ki la ong ha ki, “Phim don bynta ei ei bad ngi ha kaba tei ïa ka ïing ha u Blei jong ngi. Ngin tei hi ma ngi na ka bynta u Trai, u Blei ki Israel, kumba u Sirus, syiem Persha, u la hukum ïa ngi.”
Te ki briew jong kata ka ri ki la pynsyier bad ki la pyntieng ïa ki paidbah Juda ban tei.
Ki la pynshoi ïa ki rangbah syiem pyrshah ïa ki ban pynpulom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki, katba dang im u Sirus syiem Persha, wat haduh ka por ba synshar u Darius syiem Persha.
Ha ka basdang ka jingsynshar u Ahasuerus, ki la thoh ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba shong ha Juda bad Jerusalem.
Kumjuh ha ki sngi u Artaxerxes u Bishlam, u Mithredath, bad u Tabeel, lem bad ki lok jong ki ki la thoh sha u Artaxerxes syiem Persha; ïa ka shithi la thoh ha ka ktien Aramaik bad la pynkylla.

U Rehum u lat bad u Shimshai nongthoh ki la thoh kawei ka shithi pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem sha u syiem Artaxerxes kumne harum—9u Rehum u lat, u Shimshai nongthoh, bad kiwei pat ki lok jong ki, ki nongbishar, ki lat, ki rangbah syiem, ki nong Persha, kiba na Erekh, ki nong Babilon, ki briew kiba na Susa, kata ka mut ki nong Elam,

lem bad kiwei pat ki jait bynriew ïa kiba u Osnappar badonburom bad bakhraw u la phah mih bad u la pynshong ha ki shnong Samaria bad ha kiwei pat ki thaiñ jong ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, ki la thoh, bad
kane ka long ka nokol jong ka shithi ba ki la phah:- “Ha u Artaxerxes syiem, ki shakri jong phi bad ki briew kiba na ka jylla kaba sha lyndet ka Wah, ki phah ka jingkhublei. Te mynta

ba u syiem un dup tip, kito ki Ju kiba la wan na phi sha ngi, ki la leit sha Jerusalem. Ki dang tei biang ïa kato ka nongbah dakaid kaba shait ïaleh pyrshah; ki dang pyndep ïa ki kynroh bad ki maramot ïa ki nongrim.
Namarkata to u syiem u dei ban tip ba lada la tei biang ïa ka nongbah bad lada la pynskhem ïa ki kynroh, kine ki briew kin ym siew khajna ne musur ne khrong, kumta ka jingïoh u syiem kan sa sniew.
Te ngi kiba bam ïa ka mluh jong ka ïing syiem (namar kam long ka badei ba ngin shu peit kai ïa ka jingjah burom u syiem), ngi phah pyntip namarkata ïa u syiem,

khnang ba un dup wad ha ki dulir buh jingkynmaw jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi. Phin lap ha ki dulir buh jingkynmaw ba kane ka nongbah ka shait long kaba ïaleh pyrshah, kaba pynjynjar ïa ki syiem bad ki jylla, bad ba ïa kano kano ka jingkhihwin la kynroi hapoh jong ka naduh hyndai hynthai. Dei na kane ka daw ba ïa kane ka nongbah la pynjot thiaw.
Ngi pyntip ha u syiem ba, lada tei biang ïa kane ka nongbah, bad lada ïa ki kynroh jong ka la pynskhem, phin ym don khyndew shuh ha ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah.”
U syiem u la phah ka jubab, “Ha u Rehum u lat, u Shimshai nongthoh, bad ki lok jong ki kiba shong ha Samaria bad ha ki thaiñ baroh jong ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, ka jingkhublei. Te mynta
ïa ka shithi ba phi la phah sha nga la pule shai hakhmat jong nga.
Nga la pynmih ka hukum ban wad, bad la shem ba kane ka nongbah naduh mynbarim ka la ju ïeng ïaleh pyrshah, bad ba ïa kano kano ka jingïaleh pyrshah bad ka jingkhihwin la kynroi hapoh jong ka.
La don ruh ki syiem ki bakhraw bor ha Jerusalem, kiba la synshar ïa ka jylla baroh kawei kaba shalyndet ka Wah, bad ha kine la siew ka khajna, ka musur bad ka khrong.
Namarkata pynmih ka hukum ba ïa kine ki briew dei ban pynsangeh, bad ba ïa kane ka nongbah ym dei ban tei shuh, haduh ba yn da ïoh hukum na nga.
To sumar ban ym leh jem ha kane ka kam. Balei dei ban mih ka jingsniew ban pynjynjar ïa u syiem ?”

Te kumta haba ïa ka nokol jong ka shithi u syiem Artaxerxes la pule hakhmat u Rehum bad u Shimshai nongthoh, lem bad ki lok jong ki, ki la leit bran bran sha ki Ju ha Jerusalem, bad ki la pynsangeh ïa ki da ka bor.
Kumta ka jingtrei ban tei ïa ka ïing u Blei ha Jerusalem ka la sangeh. Kane ka jingsangeh trei ka la neh haduh ka snem ka ba-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius syiem Persha.
Te ki nongïathuhlypa u Haggai bad u Zekharia, khun u Iddo, ki la ïathuh lypa ha ki Ju kiba don ha Juda bad Jerusalem, ha ka kyrteng u Blei ki Israel, Uba don ryngkat bad ki.
Kumta u Zerubbabel u khun u Shealtiel bad u Jeshwa u khun u Jozadak ki la sdang biang ban tei ïa ka ïing u Blei ha Jerusalem. Bad ki la don lang ki nongïathuhlypa u Blei kiba ïarap ïa ki.

Ha kata ka por u Tattenai, u lat ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, u Shethar-Bezonai bad ki lok jong ki ki la wan sha ki bad ki la kylli kumne, “Mano ba ai hukum ïa phi ban tei ïa kane ka ïing bad ban pynkhlaiñ ïa kane ka kynroh?”
Bad ki la kylli sa kane, “Kiei ki kyrteng jong ki briew kiba pyntrei ïa kane ka jyntei?”

Hynrei ki khmat jong u Blei jong ki ki peit ïada ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Ju. Ym shym la pynsangeh ïa ki haduh ba yn da poi ka jingpyntip ha u Darius, bad ba une un da pynphai ka jubab da ka shithi shaphang ka kam.

Hangne harum ka nokol jong ka shithi kaba u Tattenai, u lat ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, bad u Shethar-Bozenai lem bad ki lok jong u, ki nongpynïaid kam kiba ha ka jylla shalyndet ka Wah, ki la phah sha u syiem Darius.
Ki la phah sha u ka jingpyntip kaba thoh kumne: “Ha u Darius syiem, ka jingsuk baroh!

To u syiem un tip ba ngi la leit sha ka jylla Juda, shaduh ka ïing jong u Blei bakhraw. Ïa ka la tei da ki maw ki baheh, bad ïa ki kynroh la tap da ki dieng. Ka jingtrei ka ïaid shaid shaid bad ka nangïaid shaphrang hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong ki.
Kumta ngi la kylli ïa kito ki tymmen ki san bad ngi la ong kumne ha ki, ‘Mano ba la ai hukum ïa phi ban tei ïa kane ka ïing bad ban pynkhlaiñ ïa kane ka kynroh?’
Ngi la kylli ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki, ba phin dup tip, ba ngin ïoh buh jynthoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki briew kiba long rangbah ïa ki.

Te kane ka long ka jubab jong ki ha ngi, ‘Ngi long ki shakri jong u Blei ka bneng bad ka khyndew, bad ngi tei biang ïa ka ïing ba la tei la bun snem mynta , ïa kaba uwei u syiem Israel u bakhraw u la tei bad u la pyndep.

Hynrei namarba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa u Blei ka bneng, U la aiti ïa ki ha ka kti u Nebukhadnessar syiem Babilon, u nong Khaldi, uba la pynjot ïa kane ka ïing bad u la ïalam mraw ïa ki briew sha Babilon.
La katta ruh ha ka snem banyngkong jong u Sirus syiem Babilon, u Sirus syiem u la pynmih ka hukum ba ïa kane ka ïing dei ban tei biang.

Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa kiba u Nebukhadnessar u la shim noh na ka tempyl kaba ha Jerusalem bad u la leit rah sha ka tempyl ha Babilon, u Sirus syiem u la sei noh na ka tempyl ha Babilon bad u la aiti ïa ki ha uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Sheshbassar, ïa uba u la thung lat.
Te u la ong ha u, “Shim ïa kine ki khiew ki pliang, khie leit buh ïa ki ha ka tempyl kaba ha Jerusalem, bad ai ba yn tei biang ïa ka ïing u Blei ha kajuh ka jaka.”
Te une u Sheshbassar u la wan ban seng ïa ka nongrim jong ka ïing u Blei kaba ha Jerusalem, bad naduh kata ka por haduh mynta dang ïaitei ïa ka bad kam pat dep.’

Namarkata, lada u syiem u sngewdei, to un wad ha ki jaka buhkot jong u syiem kiba ha Babilon, ban shem hi lada u syiem Sirus u la pynmih ka hukum ne em ban tei ïa ka ïing u Blei ha Jerusalem. Nangta to u syiem un sngewbha ban pyntip ïa ngi shaphang kane ka kam.”
Ynda kumta u Darius u la pynmih ka hukum, ban wad ha ki Ïing buhkot ha kiba ju buh ïa ki dulir Babilon.
Te ha Ekbatana, ka nongbah jong ka jylla Media, la lap kawei ka kot bakli ha kaba la thoh, “Ka jingbuh kynmaw.

Ha ka snem ka banyngkong jong u syiem Sirus, u Sirus syiem u la pynmih ka hukum: Shaphang ka ïing u Blei ha Jerusalem. Ïa kane ka ïing to tei biang kum ka jaka ban tyrwa jynkñia bad ban wan rah ïa ki jyntyrwa thang. Ka kynjang jong ka kan long hynriewphew pruh bad ka pyngkiang jong ka hynñiewphew pruh.
Yn don lai syrtap ki maw heh bad shi syrtap da ki dieng, bad ïa ka jinglut jingsep yn bei na ka jynkynshew u syiem.

Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa kiba na ka ïing u Blei, ïa kiba u Nebukhadnessar u la knieh na ka tempyl kaba ha Jerusalem bad u la wan rah sha Babilon, dei ban pynphai biang bad ban leit rah noh sha ka tempyl kaba ha Jerusalem, kawei pa kawei ha la ka jaka jaka. Phi dei ban buh ïa ki ha ka ïing u Blei.
“Te kumta ma phi, u Tattenai, u lat ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, u Shethar-Bozenai, bad ki lok jong phi ki nongpynïaid kam kiba ha ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, kynran noh nangta.
Wat lushia ïa ka jingtrei ha kane ka ïing u Blei; ieh u nongsynshar ki Ju bad ki tymmen ki san jong ki kin tei biang ïa kane ka ïing u Blei ha ka jaka jong ka.

Nalor kata nga pynmih sa kane ka hukum shaphang ka jingïadei jong phi bad kine ki rangbah Ju na ka bynta ka jingtei biang ïa kane ka ïing u Blei. Ïa ka jinglut jingsep dei ban siew pura ha kine ki rangbah—bad khlem pynslem—na ka khajna syiem jong ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah.

Te ïa kano kano ka jingdonkam jong ki—lada masi kyrtong, blang ne langbrot na ka bynta ki jyntyrwa thang ha ka ïing u Blei ka bneng, ne u kew, ka mluh, ka waiñ ne ka umphniang, katba donkam ki lyngdoh kiba ha Jerusalem—wat pep ban ai ïa ki man ka sngi,
ba kin dup tyrwa ki jynkñia kiba pynsngewbha ïa u Blei ka bneng, bad kin dup duwai na ka bynta ka jingim u syiem bad ki khun jong u.
Nga pynmih sa kane ka hukum ba lada uno uno u pynkheiñ ïa kane ka jingmana, yn sa sei uwei u khung na ïing jong u, yn sa suh kyndang ïa uta halor jong u, bad ïa ka ïing jong u yn sa pynjot.

To u Blei, Uba la pynlong ba ka kyrteng jong U kan shongsah hangta, Un pynkyllon ïa uno uno u syiem ne ka jait bynriew kiban sei ïa la ka kti ban pynkheiñ ïa kane ka hukum ne ban pynjot ïa ka ïing u Blei kaba ha Jerusalem. Nga u Darius nga pynmih ïa ka hukum; peit ba yn pyndep bniah ïa ka.”

Te kumta, thik kumba u syiem Darius u la phah ktien, u Tattenai, u lat ka jylla shalyndet ka Wah, u Shethar-Bozenai bad ki lok kitkam jong ki, ki la pyndep bniah ïa kata kaba u syiem Darius u la hukum.

Kumta ki rangbah Ju ki la tei shaid shaid; ki la pynshngaiñ ïa ki ktien u Haggai nongïathuhlypa bad jong u Zekharia khun u Iddo. Ki la pyndep ïa ka jingtei da ka hukum u Blei ki Israel bad da ki rai jong u Sirus, bad u Darius, [bad u Artaxerxes syiem Persha].
Ïa kane ka ïing la pyndep ha ka sngi balai jong u bnai Adar, ha ka snem bahynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Darius syiem.
Ki paidbah Israel, ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi lem bad kiwei pat kiba la wan phai na ka jinglong mraw ki la leh burom ïa ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka ïing u Blei da ka jingkmen.

Ki la tyrwa ha ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka ïing u Blei sawspah tylli ki khun langbrot, bad kum ki jyntyrwa saitpap na ka bynta ki Israel baroh khat-ar tylli ki ’langshynrang, katta tylli katba don ki jait Israel.
Te ki la buh ki lyngdoh katkum ki kynhun jong ki, bad ki Lebi katkum ki jingbynta kam jong ki, na ka bynta ki kam shakri ïa u Blei ha Jerusalem, kumba la thoh ha ka kitab u Moses.
Ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw jong u bnai u banyngkong, kiba la wan phai na ka jinglong mraw ki la rakhe ïa ka Paskha.

Namarba ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki la lah pynkhuid lang ïa lade, baroh ki la long ki bakhuid. Kumta ki la pynïap ïa u langbrot paskha na ka bynta ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jinglong mraw, na ka bynta ki para lyngdoh, bad na ka bynta ïa lade hi.

Ïa u la bam da ki paid Israel kiba la wan phai na ka jinglong mraw bad da ki briew baroh kiba la ïasoh lang bad ki, bad kiba la pynkhlad ïa lade na ki jingleh sih jong kiwei pat ki briew ka ri, ban mane ïa u Trai, u Blei ki Israel.

Da ka jingkmen, ki la rakhe ïa ka jingleh niam jong u Kpu khlem thiat hynñiew sngi, namar u Trai U la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingkmen da kaba pynlong ba u syiem Assiria un sngew sbun ïa ki, kat haduh ba un da ïarap ïa ki ha ka kam shaphang ka ïing u Blei, u Blei ki Israel.
Hadien kane, ha ka jingsynshar u Artaxerxes syiem Persha, u Esra u khun u Seraïa, u khun u Azaria, u khun u Hilkia,
u khun u Shallum, u khun u Zadok, u khun u Ahitub,
u khun u Amaria, u khun u Azaria, u khun u Meraïoth,
u khun u Zerahia, u khun u Ussi, u khun u Bukki,
u khun u Abishwa, u khun u Phinehas, u khun u Eleasar, u khun u Aron lyngdoh rangbah—

une u Esra u la leit kiew na Babilon. U la long u nongthoh u bastad ha ka aiñ u Moses kaba u Trai u Blei ki Israel U la ai. U syiem u la ai ïa u katba u pan, naba ka kti u Trai u Blei jong u ka don halor jong u.

Ha ka snem ka bahynñiew jong u syiem Artaxerxes la don ruh katto katne ngut na ki paid Israel, lem bad katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, ki nongrwai bad ki nongap khyrdop, bad ki shakri ka tempyl kiba la leit kiew sha Jerusalem.
U Esra u la wan sha Jerusalem ha u bnai u basan jong ka snem ka bahynñiew jong u syiem.

Ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u banyngkong u la sdang ban leit kiew na Babilon, bad ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u basan u la wan poi ha Jerusalem, namar ka kti ka babha jong u Blei ka la don bad u.
Naba u Esra u la buh jingmut ban duriap ïa ka aiñ u Trai, ban leh ïa ka, bad ban hikai ïa ki aiñ synshar bad ïa ki riti aiñ jong U ha Israel.
Kane ka long ka nokol jong ka shithi kaba u syiem Artaxerxes u la ai ha u Esra lyngdoh, u nongthoh u bastad ka hukum u Trai bad ki aiñ synshar jong U na ka bynta ka Israel.
“U Artaxerxes u syiem ki syiem, ha u Esra lyngdoh, u nongthoh ka aiñ u Blei jong ka bneng…Te mynta
nga pynmih ka hukum ba uno uno na ki paid Israel ne ki lyngdoh jong ki ne ki Lebi uba kwah hi ban leit sha Jerusalem, u lah ban leit bad phi
Ïa phi la phah da u syiem bad ki myntri jong u hynñiew ngut, ban leit tohkit shaphang ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem katkum ka aiñ u Blei jong phi kaba don ha ka kti jong phi,
bad ban leit rah ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u syiem bad ki myntri jong u ki la tyrwa sngewbha ha u Blei ka Israel, Uba shong ha Jerusalem,

kumjuh ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar katba phi ïoh ha ka jylla Babilon baroh kawei, lem bad ki jyntyrwa jong ki paidbah bad ki lyngdoh, kiba ki ïasynñiang na ka bynta ki ïing u Blei jong ki kaba ha Jerusalem.

Da kane ka peisa, namarkata, phi dei ban leh sumar bha ban thied ki masi kyrtong, ki blang, bad ki khun langbrot, lem bad ki jyntyrwa jynbam bad jyntyrwa jyndih, bad phin tyrwa ïa ki ha ka duwan kaba ha ka ïing u Blei jong phi kaba ha Jerusalem.
Ïa kaei kaei ba ma phi bad ki hynmen para jong phi ki i-dei ban leh da ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba dang sah, to leh katkum ka mon u Blei jong phi
Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba la aiti ha phi na ka bynta ki jinglehniam ha ka ïing u Blei jong phi, phi dei ban aiti hakhmat u Blei Uba ha Jerusalem.
Lada dang donkam peisa shuh na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei jong phi, ne lada mih kano kano ka jingdonkam, phi lah ban pynlut pynsep na ka jynkynshew u syiem.

“Te ma nga, u syiem Artaxerxes nga ai ka hukum ha ki nongbat jynkynshew kiba ha ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah. Ïa kaei kaei ba u Esra lyngdoh, u nongthoh jong ka aiñ u Blei ka bneng, u donkam na phi, to ai pynkloi,
wat haduh shispah talen ka rupa, shispah busta u kew, shispah buïam ka waiñ, shispah buïam ka umphniang, bad ka mluh pat khlem da thew eh.
Ïa kaei kaei ba u Blei ka bneng U hukum, peit ba yn leh haban da biang na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei ka bneng, ïoh ba ka jingbitar jong U ka wan hiar halor ka hima u syiem bad halor ki khun jong u.

Ngi pyntip ruh ïa phi ba yn ym bit ban shim khajna, ne musur, ne bai khrong na uno uno u lyngdoh, u Lebi, u nongrwai, u nongap jynkhang, u shakri ka tempyl, ne uno uno u kynja shakri jong kane ka ïing u Blei.

“Ma phi, ko Esra, katkum ka jingstad u Blei jong phi, kaba phi don, to thung ki nongpynïasuk bad ki nongbishar ba kin bishar ïa ki paid baroh kiba ha ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, kiba nang ïa ki aiñ u Blei jong phi. Ïa kito pat de kibym nang ïa ki, phi dei ban da hikai.
Ïa uno uno ubym kohnguh ïa ka aiñ u Blei jong phi bad ïa ka aiñ u syiem, shim tian bishar tyngeh, lada dei ban rai pynïap, ne ban beh shnong, ne ban kurup ïa ki mar ki mata jong u, ne ban set byndi.”
Long ba la kyrkhu u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, Uba la buh kum kane kaei kaei ha ka dohnud u syiem, ban pynitynnat ïa ka ïing u Trai kaba ha Jerusalem,

bad Uba la pynpaw ïa la ka jingieid ka baskhem ïa nga hakhmat u syiem bad ki myntri jong u, bad hakhmat baroh ki rangbah syiem ki badonbor. Nga la sngewshlur, namarba ka kti u Trai u Blei jong nga ka don bad nga, te kumta nga la lum lang ïa ki ’riewrangbah ka Israel ban ïaleit ryngkat bad nga.
Kine ki long kita ki rangbah ïing kur, bad kane ka long ka jinghiar pateng jong kito kiba la leit kiew ryngkat bad nga na Babilon ha ka jingsynshar u syiem Artaxerxes.
Na ki khun u Phinehas, u Gershom. Na ki khun u Ithamar, u Daniel. Na ki khun u Dabid, u Hattush,
uba na ki khun u Shekania. Na ki khun u Parosh, u Zekharia; lem bad u la buh jingkheiñ shispah sanphew ngut ki shynrang.
Na ki khun u Pahath-Moab, u Elioenai u khun u Zerahia; bad u arspah ngut ki shynrang.
Na ki khun u Zattu, u Shekania u khun u Jahasiel; bad u laispah ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Adin, u Ebed u khun u Jonathan, lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Elam, u Jeshaïa u khun u Athalia, bad hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Shephatia, u Zebadia u khun u Mikhael, lem bad phraphew ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Joab, u Obadia u khun u Jehiel, lem bad arspah khatphra ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Bani, u Shelomith u khun u Josiphia, lem bad shispah hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Bebai, u Zekharia khun u Bebai, lem bad arphew phra ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Askad, u Johanan u khun u Hakkatan, lem bad shispah shiphew ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Adonikam, ki khun khatduh, ki kyrteng jong ki dei u Eliphelet, u Jewel bad u Shemaïa, lem bad hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah.
Na ki khun u Bikbai, u Uthai bad u Zakkur, lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah.
Nga la lum lang ïa ki ha ka wah kaba tuid sha Ahava, bad ngi la ïasher dara hangta lai sngi. Katba nga dang jngoh ïa ki paidbah bad ki lyngdoh, nga la shem ba ym don mano mano na ki khun u Lebi.

Hangta nga la phah khot ïa u Elieser, u Ariel, u Shemaïa, u Elnathan, u Jarib, u Elnathan, u Nathan, u Zekharia, bad u Mehsullam, ki rangbah nongïalam, ïa u Joïarib bad u Elnathan, ki rangbah ki bastad

bad nga la phah ïa ki sha u Iddo, u ’riewrangbah ba shong ha Kasiphia. Nga la bthah artat ïa ki aïu ki dei ban ong ha u Iddo bad ki hynmen para jong u, ki shakri ka tempyl ha Kasiphia, kata ka mut, ba kin phah ki nongshakri na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei jong ngi.

Te da ka jingsbun jong u Blei jong ngi Uba don bad ngi, ki la wan ïalam sha ngi ïa uwei u briew u bastad buit, uba na ki khun u Mahli u khun u Lebi, u khun u Israel, uba kyrteng u Sherebia, lem bad ki khun bad ki kur ki jait, khatphra ngut;
u Hashabia ruh lem bad u Jeshaïa, uwei na ki khun u Merari, lem bad ki kur ki jait bad ki khun jong ki, arphew ngut ki rangbah;
nalor nangta arspah arphew ngut ki shakri tempyl ïa kiba u Dabid bad ki rangbah kitkam jong u ki la mang ban ïarap ïa ki Lebi. Ïa kine baroh la thoh kyrteng.

Te nangta nga la pynbna ban don ka jingshah jingit ha kata ka jaka, ha ka wah Ahava, ban dup pynrit ïa lade hakhmat u Blei, bad ban kyrpad na U ka jingleit lynti ka basuk basaiñ ïa ngi, ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi bad ïa ki mar ki mata jong ngi baroh.

Nga sngewlehraiñ ban pan na u syiem shipyrton ki shipai bad ki nongshong kulai ban ïada ïa ngi na u nongshun ha lynti, artat haba ngi la ïathuh ha u syiem, “Ka kti u Blei jong ngi ka don barabor bad kito baroh kiba wad ïa U, bad ka jingbitar jong U ka long kaba jubor ïa kito baroh kiba lyndet ïa U.”
Kumta ngi la shah jingit, ngi la kyrpad ïa u Blei jong ngi na ka bynta kane, bad U la shah shkor ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ngi.
Nangta nga la jied khat-ar ngut ki lyngdoh kiba kham rangbah: u Sherebia bad u Hashabia lem bad shiphew ngut ki kur ki jait jong ki.
Nga la thew hakhmat jong ki ka rupa, ka ksiar bad ki khiew ki pliang, ka jynai sngewbha ba la tyrwa da u syiem, da ki myntri, da ki bakhraw batri bad da ki Israel baroh kiba ïadon hangta.
Kumta kaba nga la thew ha ka kti jong ki ka la long shispah sanphew talen ka rupa, bad ki khiew ki pliang rupa kiba shongdor shispah talen, shispah talen ka ksiar,
arphew khuri ka ksiar kaba shongdor shihajar darik, bad ar khiew ka rnong phyrnai ka bani ka bakordor kum ka ksiar.

Nangta nga la ong ha ki, “Phi long kiba la pynkyntang ha u Trai, bad ki khiew ki pliang ki long ruh kiba la pynkyntang. Ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki long ka jyntyrwa sngewbha ha u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi.
To ap bad to sumar ïa ki haduh ba phin da thew ïa ki hakhmat ki lyngdoh rangbah, bad ki Lebi bad ki rangbah ïing kur ka Israel ha Jerusalem, hapoh ki kamra jong ka ïing u Trai.
Kumta ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki la shimti ïa ka rupa, ka ksiar bad ki khiew ki pliang ba la thew, ban rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem, sha ka ïing u Blei jong ngi.

Hadien kata ngi la mih na ka wah Ahava ha ka sngi ka bakhat-ar jong u bnai banyngkong ban leit sha Jerusalem. Ka kti u Blei ka la don bad ngi, bad U la pyllait ïa ngi na ka kti u nongshun bad na ki jingap thap ha lynti.
Ngi la poi sha Jerusalem bad ngi la shong thait hangta lai sngi.

Ha ka sngi ka basaw, ïa ka rupa, ka ksiar bad ki khiew ki pliang la thew ha ki kti u Moremoth lyngdoh, u khun u Uria. La don ryngkat bad u u Eleasar u khun u Phinehas, lem bad ki Lebi, u Jozabad u khun u Jeshwa bad u Noadia u khun u Binnui.
Ïa ki tiar baroh la ñiew bad la thew, bad ïa ka jingkhia la buh jynthoh ban kynmaw.

Ha kata ka por, kito baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ring mraw, ki la tyrwa ki jyntyrwa thang ha u Blei ki Israel, khat-ar tylli ki masi kyrtong na ka bynta ki Israel baroh khyndaiphew hynriew tylli ki blang, hynñiewphew hynñiew tylli ki khun langbrot, bad khat-ar tylli ki ’langshynrang na ka bynta ka jingkñia sait pap. Kane baroh ka la long ka jyntyrwa thang ha u Trai.
Ki la ai ruh ïa ki hukum u syiem ha ki lat rangbah bad ha ki lat jong ka jylla kaba shalyndet ka Wah, bad kine ki la ai jingïarap ïa ki paidbah bad ïa ka ïing u Blei.

Hadien kine kiei kiei, ki rangbah nongïalam ki la wan ïakynduh ïa nga, ki ong, “Ki paid Israel, ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kim shym pynkyrpang ïa lade na ki briew jong kiwei ki ri bad na ki kam khlemraiñ jong ki Kanaan, ki Hit, ki Peris, ki Jebus, ki Ammon, ki Moab, ki Ijipt bad ki Amor.

Ki la shim tnga na ki khun kynthei jong ki na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang. Kumta ka jait bynriew ka bakhuid ka la ïakhleh lang bad ki trai shnong jong kiwei ki ri. Kiba hakhmat eh ha kane ka jingshet kylla dei ki nongïalam bad ki ’riewrangbah.”
Haba nga la ïohsngew ïa kane, nga la kad ïa la ka jymphong bad ïa ka jaiñkup, nga la phut ïa la u ’ñiuhkhlieh bad u ’ñiuhtmoh, bad nga la shong thap-ngur.

Te kumta baroh kat kiba sngewtriem ïa ki ktien u Blei ki Israel, na ka daw jong ka jingshet kylla ki briew kiba wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ki la ïalum sawdong jong nga katba nga dang shong thap-ngur haduh ka jingkñia kaba janmiet.
Ha ka jingkñia kaba janmiet nga la ïeng na ka jingshah jingit, bad la ki jaiñ bad ka jaiñkup kaba la kad, bad nga la dem khohsiew da kaba piar ïa la ki kti sha u Trai u Blei jong nga.

Nga la ong, “Ko Blei jong nga, nga sngewlehraiñ bad nga sngewrem ban khmied ïa la ka khmat sha Me, a Blei jong nga, namarba ki jingbymman jong ngi ki la kiew kham kynjang ban ïa ki khlieh jong ngi, bad ka jingtngit pap jong ngi ka la kiew joit shaduh sha bneng.

Naduh ki sngi jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi haduh kane ka sngi ngi la tngit tang ka pap rynjaiñ. Na ka bynta ki kam bymman jong ngi la aiti ïa ngi, ïa ki syiem jong ngi bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong ngi ha ki kti jong ki syiem jong kiwei ki ri, ha ka waitlam, ha ka jingshah ring mraw, ha ka jingshah lute bad ha ka jingkhlemraiñ, kum ha kane ka sngi.

Hynrei mynta, kyndit kyndit, u Trai u Blei jong ngi U la pynpaw ïa la ka jingsbun da kaba pynsah ïa ngi khyndiat ngut, bad da kaba ai ïa ngi ka jakarieh hapoh ka ïing bakhuid jong U. Kumta u Blei jong ngi U la pynkmen ïa ki khmat jong ngi bad U la ai khyndiat ka jingaram ha ka jinglong mraw jong ngi.

Ngi long ki mraw, pynban u Blei jong ngi Um shym la ieh noh ïa ngi ha ka jinglong mraw. U la pynpaw ïa la ka jingieid baskhem jong U ïa ngi hakhmat ki syiem Persha, U la pynïoh ïa ngi ka jingbit ban pynïeng ïa ka ïing u Blei jong ngi, bad ban maramot ïa ki jingjot jong ka, bad U la ai ïa ngi ka jingïada ha Juda bad ha Jerusalem.
“Te mynta, ko Blei jong ngi, aïu pat ngin ong hadien kane? Naba ngi la lyndet ïa ki hukum jong Me,

kiba Me la hukum da ki shakri jong Me ki nongïathuhlypa, da kaba ong, Ka ri ba phi wan rung ban dakhol ka long ka ri bymkhuid, na ka bynta ki jingleh jakhlia jong ki briew kata ka ri, bad na ka bynta ki jingleh khlemraiñ kiba la pynjyrsieh plak ïa ka na bakut sha bakut da ka jingbymkhuid.

Namarkata wat ai ïa la ki khun kynthei ha ki khun shynrang jong ki, bad phim dei ruh ban shim ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong phi. Wat ju wad ïa ka jingsuk ne ka jingmanbha jong ki, kumta phin sa khlaiñ, phin ïoh bam ïa kaei kaei ka babha na ka ri, bad phin ïoh ieh noh pateng ïa ka ha ki khun jong phi shi junom.

Hadien kata baroh kaba la jia ha ngi namar ki kam sniew bad ka jingtngit pap jong ngi ka bakhraw—haba ngi ïohi, ko Blei jong ngi, ba Me la pynshitom ïa ngi kham duna ban ïa kaba ki kam bymman jong ngi ki la dawa, bad ba Me dang pynsah ïa ngi sa katne—14hato ngin dang pynkheiñ biang ïa ki hukum jong Me bad ngin dang ïapoikha bad ki jait bynriew kiba leh ïa kine ki kam ba-ijli? Hato Men ym bitar ïa ngi haduh ba Men da pynduh khoit ïa ngi, bad kumta yn ym don ba sah ne ba lait shuh?

Ko Trai, ko Blei ki Israel, Me long u bahok; pynban Me dang pynim ïa ngi mynta haduh kane ka sngi. Hakhmih, ngi don hakhmat jong Me ki batngit da ka pap, wat lada ngim dawa ban ïeng hakhmat jong Me namar kane.”

Katba u Esra u dang duwai bad u dang phla kumne, da ka jingïam bad da kaba dem pyllup hakhmat ka ïing u Blei, shibun bah ki paid rangbah, kynthei bad khynnah Israel ki la ïalum lwui sawdong jong u, bad ki la ïaïam pait dohnud.

U Shekania khun u Jehiel, uwei na ki khun u Elam, u la kren ha u Esra, “Ngi la shet kylla ïa la u Blei jong ngi bad ngi la shongkha ïa ki kynthei nongwei kiba na ki briew kane ka ri; lajar katta dang don jingkyrmen mynta ïa ki Israel.

Te kumta to ngin ïateh jutang bad u Blei jong ngi ban beh noh ïa kine ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki baroh, kumba u kynrad jong ngi bad kito kiba bat hok ïa ki hukum u Blei jong ngi ki phah leh. Ai ba yn leh katkum ka aiñ.
Ïeng joit, namar kane ka dei ka kam jong phi. Ngi ngin don ryngkat bad phi ha kane; phi to long u bashlur bad to leh ïa ka.”
Kumta u Esra u la ïeng joit bad u la phah smai ïa ki lyngdoh ’riewkhmat, ïa ki Lebi bad ïa ki Israel baroh ba kin leh kumba la ong. Te ki la ïasmai.

Hadien kata u Esra u la leit noh nangta nakhmat ka ïing u Blei bad u la leit sha ka kamra u Jehohanan u khun u Eliashib, bad u la sah shimiet hangta, khlem bam jynbam, khlem dih um, namar u la ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingleh haram kito kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ring mraw.
Te la pynmih ka jingpynbna ha Juda bad Jerusalem baroh kawei ba ki nongshah ring mraw kiba la wan phai ki dei ban ïalum ha Jerusalem,

bad jar ubym wan mih hapoh lai sngi, ïa ka spah ka hajar jong u baroh katba u don yn sa kurup da ka bor ki rangbah bad ki tymmen ki san; ïa u pat yn sa weng noh na ka senglang jong ki nongshah ring mraw.

Kumta baroh ki rangbah Juda bad Benjamin ki la ïalum lang ha Jerusalem hapoh lai sngi. Ka dei ka sngi ka ba-arphew jong u bnai u bakhyndai. Ki paidbah baroh ki la ïashong ha ka madan ka baïar hakhmat ka ïing u Blei, da ka jingkhynñiuh na ka bynta kane ka kam bad namarba slap artat.
Hangta u Esra lyngdoh u la ïeng joit bad u la kren ha ki, “Phi la ryngkang aiñ bad phi la shong kurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei, bad kumta phi la pynkhraw ïa ka jingkit pap ki Israel.
Mynta phla ha u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi, bad leh ïa ka mon jong U. Pynkhlad ïa lade na kiwei ki jait bynriew jong ka ri bad na ki tnga nongwei.”
Te u paidlang u la jubab ryngkat baroh da ka sur bajam, “Ka long kumta; ngi dei ban leh kumba phi la ong.
Hynrei u paid u long u babun, bad ka long ka por kaba slap jur; ngim lah ban ïeng habar. Kam dei ruh ka kam kaba tang shisngi ne ar sngi, naba ngi la ryngkang aiñ shikatdei ha kane ka kam.

Ai ba ki rangbah kin mihkhmat na ka bynta u paidlang baroh; phah ba kito baroh kiba don ha ki shnong jong ngi kiba la shim tnga nongwei kin wan ha ki por ba la buh-ïá, ryngkat bad ki tymmen ki san bad ki nongbishar kiba na man la ka shnong, haduh ba yn da pynphai noh na ngi ïa ka jingbitar ka bashyrkhei jong u Blei na ka bynta kane ka kam.”
Tang u Jonathan u khun u Asahel ba u Jahseïa u khun u Tikba ki la pyrshah ïa kane, bad ïa ki la kyrshan da u Meshullam bad u Shabbethai u Lebi.

Kumta ki nongshong mraw kiba la wan phai ki la leh kumta na man la ka ïing kur, u Esra u la jied ïa u rangbah jong ka ban ïarap, bad u la thoh kyrteng ïa ki. Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai u bashiphew, ki la ïashong ban pyrkhat ïa kane ka kam,
bad ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u banyngkong ki la pyndep ïa ka kam baroh jong kito ki briew kiba la shongkha ïa ki kynthei nongwei.

La shem ba hapdeng ki khun jong ki lyngdoh, kito kiba la ïapoi kha bad ki kynthei nongwei ki la long: na ki khun u Jeshwa khun u Jozadak bad ki hynmen para jong u u Maaseïa, u Elieser, u Jarib, bad u Gedalia.
Ki la ai ka juban ban beh noh ïa la ki tnga, bad ka jyntyrwa sait pap jong ki ka la long uwei u blang uba na ka kynhun blang na ka bynta ka pap ka sang jong ki.
Napdeng ki khun u Immer, u Hanani bad u Zebadia.
Napdeng ki khun u Harim: u Maaseïa, u Elija, u Shemaïa, u Jehiel, bad u Ussia.
Napdeng ki khun u Pashhur: u Elioenai, u Maaseïa, u Ishmael, u Nethanel, u Jozabad, bad u Elasa.
Napdeng ki Lebi: u Jozabad, u Shimei, u Kelaïa (kata ka mut, u Kelita), u Pethahia, u Juda, bad u Elieser.
Napdeng ki nongrwai: u Eliashib. Napdeng ki nongap khyrdop: u Shallum, u Telem bad u Uri.
Napdeng ki Israel: na ki khun u Parosh: u Ramia, u Issia, u Malkhija, u Mijamin, u Eleasar, u Hashabia bad u Benaïa.
Napdeng ki khun u Elam: u Mattania, u Zekharia, u Jehiel, u Abdi, u Jeremoth, bad u Elija.
Napdeng ki khun u Zattu: u Elioenai, u Eliashib, u Mattania, u Jeremoth, u Zabad, bad u Asisa.
Napdeng ki khun u Bebai ki la long u Jehohanan, u Hanania, u Zabbai, bad u Athlai.
Napdeng ki khun u Bani ki la long u Mehsullam, u Mallukh, u Adaïa, u Jashub, u Sheal, bad u Jeremoth.
Napdeng ki khun u Pahathmoab: u Adna, u Khelal, u Benaïa, u Maaseïa, u Mattania, u Besalel, u Binnui, bad u Manasse.
Napdeng ki khun u Harim: u Elieser, u Isshija, u Malkhija, u Shemaïa, u Shimeon,
u Benjamin, u Mallukh, bad u Shemaria.
Na ki khun u Hashum: u Mattenai, u Mattatta, u Zabad, u Eliphelet, u Jeremai, u Manasse, bad u Shimei.
Napdeng ki khun u Bani: u Maadai, u Amram, u Uel,
u Benaïa, u Bedeïa, u Kheluhi,
u Bania, u Meremoth, u Eliashib,
u Mattania, u Mattenai, u Jasu.
Napdeng ki khun u Binnui: u Shimei,
u Shelemia, u Nathan, u Adaïa,
u Makhnadebai, u Shashai, u Sharai,
u Asarel, u Shelemia, u Shemaria,
u Shallum, u Amaria, bad u Joseph.
Napdeng ki khun u Nebo: u Jeïel, u Mattithia, u Zabad, u Zebina, u Jaddai, u Joel, bad u Benaïa.
Kine baroh ki la shongkha ïa ki kynthei nongwei, bad ki la beh noh ïa ki bad ki khun jong ki. ___________________
